intent: Publish test definitions, independent expected outcomes, evidence references and sanitized results in public test repositories. Consolidate closely related checks into one execution/test APK when practical, normally two to four categories, while preserving separately accountable acceptance per checklist item.
private_execution_exception: When testing private app source or an unapproved test APK, run public tests in the authorized private-app GitHub Actions runner and publish bounded non-sensitive evidence back to public test repositories. Do not claim a private runner is public execution.

evidence_rules.road_legality: Relevant current UK legislation, traffic orders, Highway Code, DfT signs/markings, corroborated sign/layout records—not DriveMate output or a competitor's output.
evidence_rules.road_geometry: Third-party real UK road data with contributor/record identity, date and licence, plus corroboration of signs and lawful movements where needed.
evidence_rules.simulation: Allowed for TomTom/network failures and GPS replay, but must be labelled synthetic; never substitute simulated roads for externally verified road truth.
evidence_rules.pass_condition: Actual app classes or identified APK exercised; independent expected results; exact build SHA, public test SHA, detailed per-item pass/fail/missing; results from only test code or an invented road cannot sign off road correctness.

apk_policy.test_apk_grouping: Prefer one internal debug/test APK pair for 2–4 related categories, built once after shared source/fixture setup. Do not build one APK per checklist item.
apk_policy.public_release: No APK (including debug/test APK) may be published publicly until required automated, replay and navigation-robot release gates pass and distributable contents are explicitly approved. Public test sources/results are not public APK releases.
apk_policy.private_binary: Private app source, credentials and raw personal drive data stay private; test APKs requiring the private app may run inside authorized private CI.
apk_policy.no_tomtom_key: TomTom network fixtures must be simulated, clearly labelled, and contain no provider key.
